<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#143CC9"/>
      <stop offset="62%" stop-color="#5D78E1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="4"/>
      <feOffset dy="4"/>
      <feComponentTransfer><feFuncA type="linear" slope=".22"/></feComponentTransfer>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="18" y="21" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2">
    <line x1="324" y1="20" x2="324" y2="16"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="20" x2="329" y2="13"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="20" x2="334" y2="10"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7">
    <path d="M343 14 Q348 9 353 14"/>
    <path d="M345 17 Q348 14 351 17"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="348" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="361" y="11" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="382" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <circle cx="35" cy="67" r="15" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
  <polyline points="40,60 33,67 40,74" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="61" y="74" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Contact Us</text>

  <!-- Main information card -->
  <rect x="19" y="101" width="352" height="532" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity=".18"/>
  <rect x="19" y="97" width="352" height="532" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>

  <text x="40" y="132" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">
    <tspan x="40" dy="0">GET IN TOUCH</tspan>
    <tspan x="40" dy="30" font-size="13" font-weight="700">VISIT OUR CINEMA</tspan>
    <tspan x="40" dy="25" font-size="15" font-weight="400">125 Grand Avenue</tspan>
    <tspan x="40" dy="22" font-size="15" font-weight="400">Downtown, NY 10018</tspan>
    <tspan x="40" dy="35" font-size="13" font-weight="700">PHONE</tspan>
    <tspan x="40" dy="25" font-size="16" font-weight="400">+1 (212) 555-0186</tspan>
    <tspan x="40" dy="34" font-size="13" font-weight="700">EMAIL</tspan>
    <tspan x="40" dy="25" font-size="15" font-weight="400">hello@seatcinema.example</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- location icon -->
  <g transform="translate(319 157)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="13" fill="#143CC9"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="-3" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polygon points="-7,0 0,12 7,0" fill="#143CC9"/>
  </g>
  <!-- phone icon -->
  <g transform="translate(319 286)" fill="none" stroke="#143CC9" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
    <path d="M-7 -9 L-3 -11 L1 -4 L-2 -1 Q1 5 7 7 L9 4 L15 8 L12 13 Q-1 12 -8 -1 Q-12 -7 -7 -9"/>
  </g>
  <!-- mail icon -->
  <g transform="translate(319 352)">
    <rect x="-15" y="-10" width="30" height="21" rx="3" fill="#143CC9"/>
    <polyline points="-13,-8 0,1 13,-8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <line x1="40" y1="385" x2="350" y2="385" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Hours block -->
  <text x="40" y="420" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">
    <tspan x="40" dy="0">HOURS OF OPERATION</tspan>
    <tspan x="40" dy="30" font-size="15" font-weight="400">Monday – Thursday</tspan>
    <tspan x="335" dy="0" text-anchor="end" font-size="15" font-weight="700">10:00 AM – 11:00 PM</tspan>
    <tspan x="40" dy="25" font-size="15" font-weight="400">Friday – Sunday</tspan>
    <tspan x="335" dy="0" text-anchor="end" font-size="15" font-weight="700">9:00 AM – 12:00 AM</tspan>
    <tspan x="40" dy="28" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Box office closes 30 minutes after the final show.</tspan>
  </text>

  <line x1="40" y1="534" x2="350" y2="534" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Policy -->
  <g>
    <rect x="40" y="552" width="24" height="24" rx="4" fill="#143CC9"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="559" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="52" y1="563" x2="52" y2="571" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <text x="76" y="565" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">
    <tspan x="76" dy="0">AGE POLICY</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="20" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Guests under 17 must be accompanied</tspan>
    <tspan x="76" dy="17" font-size="12" font-weight="400">by an adult after 8:00 PM.</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Social section -->
  <rect x="19" y="648" width="352" height="82" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity=".18"/>
  <rect x="19" y="644" width="352" height="82" rx="13" fill="#E0E0E0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="39" y="672" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">FOLLOW THE LATEST</text>

  <g transform="translate(205 668)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="16" fill="#000000"/>
    <path d="M3 -9 L-1 -9 Q-5 -9 -5 -5 L-5 9 L1 9 L1 2 L5 2 L6 -3 L1 -3 L1 -5 Q1 -6 3 -6 L6 -6 L6 -9 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(253 668)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="16" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="-7" y="-7" width="14" height="14" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="5" cy="-5" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(301 668)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="16" fill="#000000"/>
    <path d="M-8 -7 Q-4 -5 -1 -5 Q3 -10 7 -6 L10 -7 Q9 -4 7 -3 Q9 -3 10 -3 Q8 0 5 1 Q2 10 -7 8 Q-3 8 -1 6 Q-5 6 -7 3 Q-5 3 -3 2 Q-7 1 -8 -2 Q-6 -2 -5 -2 Q-8 -4 -8 -7 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <text x="205" y="705" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000" text-anchor="middle">
    <tspan x="205">FACEBOOK</tspan><tspan x="253">INSTAGRAM</tspan><tspan x="301">TWITTER</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="764" width="390" height="80" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g transform="translate(47 787)">
    <polygon points="-11,-2 0,-12 11,-2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="-7" y="-2" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(145 787)">
    <rect x="-11" y="-9" width="22" height="18" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="-6" y1="-4" x2="6" y2="-4" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="-6" y1="2" x2="4" y2="2" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(243 787)">
    <rect x="-10" y="-9" width="20" height="16" rx="6" fill="#143CC9"/>
    <polygon points="-4,7 -1,13 4,7" fill="#143CC9"/>
    <line x1="-5" y1="-3" x2="5" y2="-3" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="-5" y1="2" x2="3" y2="2" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(341 787)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="-5" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="9" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <text x="47" y="820" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000" text-anchor="middle">
    <tspan x="47">HOME</tspan><tspan x="145">TICKETS</tspan><tspan x="243" fill="#143CC9">CONTACT</tspan><tspan x="341">PROFILE</tspan>
  </text>
</svg>
